method: Direct image-tool inspection of PNG previews and separately rasterized actual SVG masters at 1920x1080. SVGs were rendered by CairoSVG 2.8.2, not checked only by header or size.

checks: Official embedded Azure icons render, including App Service, Cosmos, Blob, ACR, Bastion, NAT, Entra, DNS and workspace Insights.
Labels are legible at normal 1920x1080 overview size; final connector corridors do not cross card text or boundary labels.
Sweden Central workload and isolated VNet boundaries are distinct; managed PaaS is outside the VNet; shared DNS and qualified Entra are outside the workload-region frame.
Private ingress is distinct from outbound integration; 730h app platform egress is independent of 80h runner-only NAT.
Four steady endpoints and conditional new-account/PE recovery are distinct; no fifth steady dependency or regional failover is drawn.
Runtime Unverified and assumed-policy qualification are visible; monitoring public access is explicitly conditional.
views.layout_repairs: Moved independent top/left egress and operator routes out of header text; separated DNS from the private request bus; moved access public-IP caption away from runner telemetry.

checks: All four exact subnet CIDRs, VNet prefix and unused growth reserve are readable.
Delegation, NSG/route-table semantics and Disabled PE network policies are visible without claiming endpoint filtering.
Four central zone names and PaaS target mappings are readable; App/SCM and ACR regional records are called out.
Operator and DNS routes use margins rather than crossing header text; arrows stay clear of unrelated cards.
Native Entra SSH, no public VM NIC, service-owned IPs and independent app egress are explicit.
Conditional restore PE and future-authorized deletion billing qualification are visible.
views.layout_repairs: Routed operator through the left margin and DNS through the right-hand corridor; changed wording to planned subnet rows.

limitations: Rasterized-SVG visual check exercises the actual embedded symbols and text, but is not a second independent browser-engine review.
No runtime connectivity, Azure state, performance, policy enforcement or recovery test was performed.
